items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: different spots before I went to work at Eddie Condon’s in Greenwich Village. That was in 1948.

ctx.x: Yeah I think so, quite a bit now. So you had a reputation, at least you had on your resume that you played with Teagarden. Did that help you get your next engagement?

Well I worked like at the Hickory House and the Village Vanguard. This was after I got my union card. The Embers, they used to call it “The Numbers,” The Embers, and different spots before I went to work at Eddie Condon’s in Greenwich Village. That was in 1948.
